title: UiKit component reference
description: GTS id of another kit component: the well-known instance of the component type that component IS. `x-gts-instance-ref` declares what it must resolve to, and a GTS store checks it; `type` and `pattern` check the grammar for a reader without one.
$comment: GTS tokens are snake_case; kit directories are kebab-case (navigation_menu -> navigation-menu).
